Show a clearly warm, relaxed happy expression that is visibly different from the neutral source: friendly softly arced brows, a gentle happy eye-smile with slight lifted lower lids and tiny outer-corner smile creases. Keep the eyes narrow and calm, not surprised, alarmed, angry, or near-neutral. Keep the center fringe and side hair exactly in place; preserve all original hair pixels in the top corners. Keep both eyes aligned and the original amber/olive-brown iris color, compact stepped iris clusters, tiny muted pale highlights, skin tones, and soft pixel-art palette.

Make a consistent happy brow and eye-expression master across OPEN, HALF, CLOSED, and OPEN REPEAT. OPEN has the narrow natural source aperture. HALF is visibly a half blink with upper lids covering much of the iris. CLOSED is fully gently closed with continuous natural lids. OPEN REPEAT matches OPEN. Keep changes within the existing eye/brow envelopes; do not recolor or redraw the center fringe, side hair, face exterior, nose, or mouth. No oversized irises, broad white bands, bright glints, vector smoothness, blur, gradients, text, watermark, or extra subjects.
